answer_1.quote: Knowledge-intensive tasks such as question answering (QA), fact checking, and dialogue generation require models to gather relevant information from potentially enormous knowledge corpora (e.g., Wikipedia) and generate answers based on gathered evidence.

answer_2.quote: We report top-k retrieval accuracy (R@k), the fraction of queries with at least one retrieved document containing answers. We compare QA performance with ORQA, REALM, RAG, FiD, EMDR 2 , YONO, UnitedQA, and R2-D2 using exact match (EM)
